When you start Listen on a story, should music start by itself?

❯ 1. No, I'll tap play
     Music remembers your last selection and position but only starts when you tap play on the music card.
  2. Optional setting, off
     Add 'Start music with Listen' to the card, off by default. When on, starting a story resumes your last music.
  3. Always resume if it was on
     If music was playing when you last used Listen, it picks back up when you start a story.
  4. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
